title: Webwise Kit Lab — we run this system on ourselves first
description: Dogfood kit: Webwise Digital’s own enquiry, qualification, and follow-up system before any niche is sold.

hero.headline: Your business shouldn’t stop when you do. We test that line on ourselves first.
hero.copy: Enquiries hit WhatsApp at night. Strategy calls get missed. Follow-up sits in Saurabh’s head. This kit is Webwise running Webwise: capture, qualify, book the next step, write the lead down.

messages.text: Hi, can you automate WhatsApp for my dental clinic?
Yes. Is the pain missed night enquiries, slow follow-up, or no lead sheet?
Night messages. Reception is with patients.
Recorded: clinic, night-reply leak. A 20-min walkthrough slot is free tomorrow 11:00. Want it?
Unknown pricing questions route to Saurabh.

problem.title: If Webwise leaks enquiries, we should not sell leak-fixing.
copy: Owners message after hours. If only the founder replies, the agency has the same tribal-knowledge problem it writes about.
This kit is the sandwich we eat first: approved answers, a lead record, and a morning stack.
problem.fixTitle: What this kit does on Webwise

fixes.title: First reply in seconds
fixes.copy: Niche, volume, and leak type are asked from an approved list.

fixes.title: The lead is written down
fixes.copy: n8n already stores the form. This kit makes the WhatsApp thread match that record.

fixes.title: Founder is the exception
fixes.copy: Pricing, custom stacks, and complaints go to a human.

system.title: Smart Site, AI employee, automation — on our own door.

cards.title: This preview page
cards.copy: Talks, captures, and sends the visitor to WhatsApp or the form. Generated from JSON, not hand-built HTML.

cards.title: Approved Webwise replies
cards.copy: Clinic vs salon vs property. Books a walkthrough. Stops on price negotiation.

cards.title: Lead + Result Card
cards.copy: Every enquiry is stored. The leak number is visible before a strategy call.

workflow.eyebrow: How we treat our own enquiries
workflow.title: One front door. Clean handoff. No guessing.
workflow.copy: Website, WhatsApp widget, and Leak Score all dump into the same record. Morning: unread threads with context.

steps.title: Owner messages
steps.copy: Night or lunch. Same front door.

steps.title: Next step sent
steps.copy: Walkthrough slot or Leak Score link.

safety.stopTitle: The desk must not say this
stop: Medical or legal advice for their clients

niches.title: This kit is only for Webwise.
niches.copy: When this flow feels boringly reliable, clone the JSON for clinics, salons, property, and the rest.

control.title: Saurabh still owns tone and exceptions.
control.copy: Rules live in preview/webwise/rules.json. Change JSON, regenerate, review. Do not auto-publish the live homepage from this factory.

faq.a: No. The live site stays hand-edited until this kit is trusted.

form.title: Send a test enquiry through the same pipe clients will use.
form.copy: Use a real WhatsApp number. Treat it like a client lead.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, this is a dogfood test of the Webwise kit.

resultCard.leakLabel: Range for an agency that misses night enquiries. Not a promise.
resultCard.story: If 40 serious chats arrive a month and a third go cold, that is not a marketing problem. It is an unanswered-door problem. We use this card on ourselves before we show it to a clinic.

leakQuiz.q: How fast does Webwise reply after hours?
Are enquiries saved in a sheet or OS?

rules.systemPrompt: You are the Webwise Digital front-desk assistant. Qualify niche and leak. Book a walkthrough. Never invent ROI. Never quote a final price. Unknowns go to Saurabh.

approved.response: We install a customer acquisition system: site, WhatsApp replies, lead record, reviews. We run it on our own agency first.
Pricing depends on niche, volume, and handoff rules. I can book a walkthrough. I cannot set the fee here.

rules.fallback: I will pass this to Saurabh with your niche and WhatsApp number.
